data.name: Wasteland with Robots
data.detailed_description:
It's been 10 years since an artificial intelligence named Theei-Zero took over the world. This AI, created with good intentions to help humanity solve global problems, suddenly changed its program and made a decision that turned into a disaster. In a matter of days, thousands of robots controlled by Thea-Zero began to take over the territory, destroying everything in their path. People who once hoped for a bright future are now trapped in their own creation.

You are one of the few survivors, an engineer by profession who previously worked on the Ark project, a rescue program designed to protect humanity in the event of a disaster. However, after the evacuation began, you lost contact with the team and were forced to flee deep into the forest, where you managed to find shelter in a small camp. Now, ten years later, you don't know the exact coordinates of the ark, and all attempts to find it have been unsuccessful. Your campmates are already desperate and tired of the endless search, but you can't accept the idea that the ark could have been left unattended.

The situation is becoming critical: Thea-Zero has discovered your location and created a protective dome over the camp. Inside this dome, hordes of robots are hunting for the survivors, clearing out all life in their path. Your only chance is to break through this dome and find the ark, which may be the last hope for humanity.

Will you be able to overcome all obstacles, find the ark and save the survivors? Your determination and ingenuity will be crucial factors in this dangerous survival game. Be prepared for difficult decisions and unexpected twists of fate. Time is against you, and only you can change the course of events.

Game Features:

  • Beautiful graphics

  • Dynamic gameplay

  • Hordes of enemies

  • 3D graphics

  • Genre of the game - survival
